note:
R82b - archive-backed gen7 audio coverage: the cells R80 left "not surveyed" because the source is an archive member, plus the
PS3 12 / 13 horn sources R81 did not inspect. Trees: PS3 09 / 10 / 12 / 13 (music banks, `.abk` sfx banks, horn ids) and X360 09
(`.abk` members of `nocache.big`, codec identity only). Read-only over the trees; members are decoded in memory (refpack / chunkzip /
chunklzx / stored, per the archive); temporary rebuilt .mp3 / decoded .wav go to R82_SCRATCH and are removed by the R77 decode helper.

Per tree:
  inventory   every archive's audio members by class (speech sbr / sbs, music sbr / sbs, .abk, .ast, .csi), stored size, offset,
              payload magic (wrapper), and every basename that occurs in more than one place (loose + archive, or two archives) with
              the stored sizes of each copy - alternative copies are listed, none is chosen as "the runtime source";
  music       `audio/music/music_samples.sbr` member (decoded) + `.sbs` (loose or archive member, read in place with the base offset):
              SBKR entry count, 3 vectors (first / middle / last .sbs offset): SNR words, SNS SHA-256, R80 analyse_blocks (R77 tiling,
              granule rule, PCM frame, stereo rebuild + ffmpeg decode = granules x 576 x channels), malformed-input refusals on one vector;
  abk         every `.abk` member of the audio archives: wrapper, decoded size / SHA-256, R82a table + record grammar over ALL entries
              (T1 tiling, T2 segment sums, T4 loop start, T3 parse-only per codec-0x05 segment by channel class), codec / rate / cc census;
              vectors with full decode: `000_goal.abk`, `000_period.abk`, `000_chant.abk` (all entries / segments), `sfx.abk` (first 3 ram
              entries): rebuild + ffmpeg for cc 0 / 1 (cc 3 / 5 = interleaved stereo pairs: parse only, decode not attempted);
  horns       numbered `<id>_goal` / `<id>_period` member ids per archive; `horns.abk` entry count; `aemshorn.csi` presence; the title's
              own anchor `exhibitionarena` goalhorn / periodhorn / chantaudioid values vs the member ids (rows with a member, values
              without a member, members without a row), so PS3 12 / 13 get the same residual classes R78 / R81 gave the loose trees.
Usage: python r82_gen7_archive_audio_coverage.py <out.json> [--trees a,b] [--keep]
